NOR VTS information service for routeing schemes south of 65N exists (contact line) but is not a VTS area and involves no mandatory report. TSS-0074.unresolved_issue: Resolved at Pass 4: the Regulation on vessels' notification obligations (2015 no. 1790) contains no transit reporting duty south of 67 10 N, so the earlier residual doubt about an unlisted national scheme is closed. Open project rule: NOR VTS (Vardø) monitors routeing measures outside the statutory VTS areas; if that counts as VTS coverage, all 19 Norwegian TSS move up one class.

TSS-0085.reporting_boundary_basis: MSC.190(79) para 2.1: the WETREP polygon runs 56°30'N 012°W - 54°40'41"N 015°W - 50°56'45"N 015°W - 48°27'N 006°25'W, with the inner closing point 21 on the Irish east coast (52°10'N 006°22'W). At Fastnet's longitude (c. 009°36'W) the southern boundary line lies near 49°23'N, about 2° south of the TSS, so the TSS (off Fastnet Rock, c. 51°18'-51°23'N) is wholly inside. Applies only to oil tankers >600 dwt carrying heavy crude, heavy fuel oil or bitumen/tar; WETREP does not name the TSS. Pass 4: MSC.190(79) annex para 6.2.1 names 'Off Fastnet Rock' among the TSS in the WETREP area. Applies to oil tankers over 600 dwt carrying heavy grade oil.

TSS-0087.unresolved_issue: Partial WETREP coverage by coordinate comparison against the 1973/1996 centreline; confirm on current chart. No Irish coastal VTS source found; Irish Coast Guard VTS status not researched to exhaustion. WETREP para 6.2.1 also names Off Skerries, which lies beyond both Irish Sea closing lines; the list does not match the boundary, so coordinates govern.

TSS-0091.reporting_boundary_basis: Boundary inclusion (not named: TSS adopted 2006, after MSC.190(79)). WETREP area runs from the UK coast out to the line 56 30 N 012 W to 62 N 003 W; the TSS (about 57 24-57 29 N, 006 49-006 58 W) lies well inside. Tanker-only. Pass 4: Minches are UK internal waters but WETREP's coast-based area does not exclude them.

TSS-0095.unresolved_issue: Coverage rests on coordinate comparison with narrow margins (about 0.2' of longitude); consolidated current text of DL 263/2009 not opened; DGRM own web page not opened. Whether Decree-Law 263/2009 has been amended could not be confirmed (Diario da Republica page empty).

TSS-0088._reason: Pass 4: WETREP para 6.2.1 names Off Skerries but the boundary excludes the Irish Sea; conflict within the IMO text, so reporting is Unresolved, not No.
